review_summary.consensus: The iPhone 17 has garnered a variety of opinions, with many praising its display and camera capabilities while others criticize its pricing. Overall, it is seen as a solid option for those seeking a high-quality smartphone, but the cost remains a significant concern for some.

[3] With pricing starting at $1,399 AUD, nobody sane could call the iPhone 17 'cheap'

[10] The iPhone 17 is seen as an enticing option if you are looking for a reliable smartphone
